name: Guarding Sweephilt
description: Turn the strong part of the blade against the foe's thrust to carry it wide of the chest.

name: Lungeflog
description: Answer a parried thrust with a straight extension before the foe has drawn his arm back.

name: Veering Stoccata
description: Choose the length of the lunge by the gap so the point arrives exactly at full reach.

name: Soothing Needlepoint
description: Rest in guard for one slow breath and read the foe's weight from the tilt of his shoulders.

name: Sweptscreen
description: Sweep the foe's blade aside with a qi-edged forte and thrust into the opened chest in the same beat.

name: Rough Whipblade
description: Let the foe's first thrust pass and send a riposte over his extended arm as he tries to recover.

name: Flechebuckle
description: Dip the point under the foe's blade and lift it on the far side to show him an opened line.

name: Remiseflog
description: Glide the point along the foe's blade toward his hand and thrust into the wrist when it reaches the cup.

name: Remisecurl
description: Sidle one foot at a time across the floor without lifting the soles so the foe hears nothing.

name: Resolute Cuphilt
description: Hold the blade angled across the inner line to turn the foe's first probe before it arrives.

name: Kindly Counterpoise
description: Watch which of the foe's lines stands open after each exchange and note it for the next.

name: Lassoing Slimtang
description: Slip under the foe's parry twice in one beat and thrust through the line left bare by his second block.

name: Pasguard Buckle
description: Pass the point through the gap between the foe's hilt and blade to prick the hand that holds it.

name: Remise Buckle
description: Strike the weak third of the foe's blade near its point to jerk his thrust off its line.

name: Duskvolte
description: Press the foe's blade down with a firm beat so he cannot raise the point for one moment.

name: Weighty Tipwhip
description: Wind the forte over the foe's blade and carry it down to the low line while keeping contact.

name: Rill Bellguard
description: Slip out of a foe's bind by dropping the point and circling beneath his steel.

name: Clayswept
description: Return at once to a covering guard after each beat so the foe's riposte meets steel.

name: Lunar Cupedge
description: Count the beats of the exchange silently to learn when the foe's guard loosens.

name: Gagging Tipwhip
description: Beat the foe's blade aside with a qi-charged forte and lunge into the line it leaves.

name: Stampfoil
description: Bind the foe's blade and carry it across to the outer line then thrust to the shoulder.

name: Layered Bellguard
description: Describe a tight circle with the point to wind the foe's blade around and off the line.

name: Rooted Cupedge
description: Sweep the whole blade in a broad circle to clear a rush of thrusts from the high line.

name: Honed Volte
description: Finish the parrying circle with a lunge into the chest in the same smooth motion.

name: Purpose Needlepoint
description: Keep the wrist loose and the elbow still so the circles stay small and the point stays true.

name: Grit Sweephilt
description: Retreat one pace as the circle closes so the foe's blade is left behind your hilt.

name: Cuphilt Barrier
description: Rest the point at the end of each circle on the foe's face to bar his answering thrust.

name: Counterpoise Screen
description: Spin a ring of qi around the blade as it circles so the foe's steel is dragged wide.

name: Splice Passata
description: Circle against the direction of the foe's circle to bind his blade and thrust beneath it.

name: Lassoing Lunge
description: Circle both blades together and wrench the foe's hilt sideways until his weapon leaves his grip.

name: Miragevolte
description: Flick the point at the foe's eye to draw his parry then pass it to the other line.

name: Recallfoil
description: Dip the shoulder as though to lunge low so the foe drops his guard and exposes the chest.

name: Lassoing Fleche
description: Dart the point toward the thigh and snap it up again so the foe's blade follows the wrong line.

name: Static Slimtang
description: Thrust over the foe's extended hand into his shoulder as he commits to a long lunge.

name: Draught Passata
description: Step back as though in retreat and draw the foe into a lunge that falls short.

name: Candor Pasguard
description: Watch how the foe's blade answers a feint so his habits of parry become known.

name: Pashasp
description: Keep the blade covering the line behind every feint so a sudden counter finds a guard.

name: Recall Volte
description: Offer two false attacks to opposite lines and lunge on the third before the foe's blade settles.

name: Stoccata Scorer
description: Meet the foe's parry with a thrust that circles around it the moment it closes.

name: Ember Whipblade
description: Feint a thrust low and cut with the point over the foe's arm to open the forearm.

name: Pasglide
description: Bring the rear foot past the front in a long stride to close the gap while the point stays level.

name: Pirouetting Fleche
description: Draw the front foot back past the rear in one long step to leave the foe's reach.

name: Dense Pasguard
description: Stop the pass with the legs crossed and the blade covering to catch a sudden counter at the midpoint.

name: Counterpoise Hammerfall
description: Thrust at the end of the stride with the rear foot just landing and the whole body behind the point.

name: Sure Needlepoint
description: Pause after each stride to feel whether both feet carry weight evenly before the next move.

name: Rugged Remise
description: Cross the legs and lunge in the same beat so the foe's retreat is too slow to escape the point.

name: Fleet Fleche
description: Pass beneath the foe's thrusting arm while turning his blade aside and gain his flank.

name: Voltestalk
description: Step in and out just beyond the foe's reach to learn the exact gap where his thrust lands.

name: Sleetpas
description: Keep the gap long and the point at his face so he cannot close without being met.

name: Clay Cupedge
description: Meet a foe who has entered close with the forte and the cup to stop his short thrusts.

name: Kindly Whipblade
description: Count the foe's tempo of steps until the beat on which his front foot hangs unplanted becomes clear.

name: Foilslap
description: Thrust in the gap between the foe's two steps when his weight is neither forward nor back.

name: Prowling Volte
description: Retreat a full pace the instant his lunge begins so it ends one finger short.

name: Sweephilt Slap
description: Slide a half step forward in the foe's own retreat and lunge before he restores the gap.

name: Tipwhip Hasp
description: Catch the foe's thrust at its start with a qi-edged parry and thrust in the beat he loses.

name: Volteswat
description: Drop the point to the knee and prick the leg with a short quick extension under the guard.

name: Passcreen
description: Hold the blade at the hip with the point forward to cover the low line and the belly.

name: Fleet Lunge
description: Sink the hips and step low beneath the foe's blade to reach the line he leaves open.

name: Sturdy Slimtang
description: Rise from the crouch with the blade held across the body so a cut at the head finds steel.

name: Rushing Bellguard
description: Lunge low beneath the foe's raised arm with a pulse of qi and strike the hip or thigh.

name: Lunge Scorer
description: Run the point just above the floor toward the foe's leading foot to pin it or stop his step.

name: Brisk Volte
description: Thrust at the wrist of the foe's weapon arm as he advances so his lunge is checked.

name: Blank Stoccata
description: Prick the foe's forward knee as he steps in so the step fails and his balance wavers.

name: Shardfoil
description: Raise the guard over the stop-thrust so a foe who ignores the point meets the steel.

name: Genial Cuphilt
description: Watch for the lift of the foe's heel that tells you his advance is about to begin.

name: Pascurl
description: Slip back and aside after a stop-thrust so a foe who presses on finds no body to strike.

name: Weighty Cupedge
description: Present the point at the foe's lead arm and hold it still so he must come onto it or stand.

name: Brasspas
description: Meet the advancing foe with a thrust in the single beat his front foot is lifted.

name: Passata Hasp
description: Stop the foe's lunge with the point then bind his blade and drive in before he can free it.

name: Foilscorer
description: Slip the stop-thrust through the foe's parry as his blade starts to move across the line.
